rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: split:refrain.1.1: can: The second 'Rejoice!' (p112-strip800.jpg system 3, the refrain in the middle row) follows an exclamation mark, so its capital is no sign. But the header (p112-strip0.jpg) prints 8.8.8.8.8.8. with no 'Ref.': the stanza's four lines and the refrain's two each count eight syllables (refrain ends on p112-strip1600.jpg system 4), and a split after word 2 makes lines of two and six syllables, which the metre breaks.
